name: ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base

lineage.how_derived: pre-trained from scratch on 33.5T tokens with the Muon optimiser; the checkpoint at the end of pre-training, before any mid- or post-training. No instruct or reasoning model of ERNIE 5.5 Flash is released as open weights on these cards.

purpose: The card releases the base checkpoint as a common starting point for domain adaptation, instruction tuning and reinforcement-learning research. A text-only 280B-A14B MoE; the vendor says different domains, reasoning tasks and agent applications need different data and training objectives, so only the base is shared.

Users in the EU, UK or South Korea have no licence at all.

architecture.kind: hybrid-attention sparse MoE (Multi-Router Latent MoE) with manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections and MultiMax head
architecture.attention: 37 Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA) layers (one cache entry per 128 tokens, head dim 512) and 6 MLA layers with sparse attention (MLA + DSA, head dim 256), 64 heads, 1 dense FFN layer and 42 latent MoE layers
architecture.drafter: ECHO: the backbone's final layer doubles as the draft model (0.36B extra parameters excluded from the totals)
architecture.why_this_design: The card gives reasons per component: one in seven layers keeps full-context access via MLA while the rest use HCA to cut the KV cache; head dimensions are matched to each layer's cost; Multi-Router replaces a single router because one router's scores correlate only weakly with expert utility; ECHO reuses the final layer instead of a separate MTP module so the multi-horizon loss shapes next-token parameters.

variants.format: GGUF mixed quants of an abliterated (refusal-removed) variant
variants.notes: Mix-60G 59.98, Mix-122G 121.99, Mix-245G 244.61 GB; weights are modified, quality not documented in what was read; file sizes only

pc-12gb.notes: smallest GGUF (60 GB, modified weights) against about 60 GB budget leaves nothing for KV; no unmodified GGUF exists

pc-16gb.notes: 60 GB against about 64 GB (13.6 VRAM + 50 RAM), abliterated weights, unknown quality, base model only

pc-24gb.notes: 60 GB against about 104 GB; same caveats

pc-32gb.notes: 122 GB against about 158 GB (29.6 VRAM + 128 RAM); the weights are an abliterated variant of a base model

mac-64gb+.notes: 60 GB file against about 52 GB GPU share on a 64 GB Mac

engine_support.notes: The community GGUFs exist, but llama.cpp support was not verified.

strengths: Leads its three named 13 to 21B-active comparison bases on most rows of the vendor table, with a 128x-compressed KV cache for most layers
weaknesses: Base model only: no chat or agent behaviour
Licence excludes the EU, the UK and South Korea
best_for: domain adaptation and RL research outside the excluded territories
avoid_for: any use in the EU, UK or South Korea
soft.maturity: Baidu ERNIE line; the licence is new (2026-11-05) and was written for this release.

tona_fit.reason: A base checkpoint, not an agent model, and the licence grants no rights in the EU, UK or South Korea (and bars use of outputs there), which excludes a large part of our users; commercial use needs attribution and a notice. Size is also large (288 GB FP8) and the only GGUFs are abliterated third-party builds.
